title: RED FRIDAY

stories.headline: THE AI SELL-OFF GOES GLOBAL
stories.facts: Nikkei -4.8% to 56,594.94 (seven-month low); Kospi -5.2%; Taiwan Taiex -6% (worst week since 1991, -16%); Hang Seng near bear market; SoftBank -14.6%, Kioxia -11.3%, Advantest -10.6%; Nasdaq -2.3% (23,879.20), S&P 500 -2% (7,176), fifth straight day of losses; Anthropic record $81.3bn IPO opened $111.50 vs $83 offer, closed +17% at $97.17.

stories.headline: MISSILE HITS RIYADH'S TALLEST TOWER
stories.facts: Houthi missile damaged the PIF Tower, Riyadh's tallest skyscraper, 80 floors, HQ of the Saudi sovereign wealth fund. Windows blown out across 7-8 floors, metal facade bent, no injuries; King Abdullah Financial District evacuated. Strike Thursday evening; second such hit on the district in under two weeks (after the Aramco building on 8 Nov).

stories.headline: COP31 DROPS FOSSIL-FUEL PHASE-OUT
stories.facts: COP31 in Antalya, Turkey: the draft deal drops any call to phase out fossil fuels.

stories.headline: GAZA: TROOPS CROSS YELLOW LINE
stories.facts: Israeli forces cross the Yellow Line in central Gaza, first incursion across the ceasefire boundary since the truce.

stories.headline: KENYA: LAST EBOLA PATIENT GOES HOME
stories.facts: Last Ebola patient discharged, 37 days after the first case.

stories.headline: UK pledges 1,000+ drones for Ukraine in a 260m-pound package; California subpoenas Nvidia over China chips; Bukele registers for a third term in El Salvador; Trump posthumously pardons baseball legend Pete Rose; Brent crude $92.77.
